briefings.title: Iran War LIVE: Arnab Exclusive With Former Trump Insider Frederick H. Fleitz

people.name: Frederick H. Fleitz
people.role: Former Trump Insider & Former CIA Analyst

briefings.tldr: Amidst conflicting claims of a decisive military victory and stalled back-channel negotiations, President Donald Trump faces a high-stakes decision between executing a risky ground invasion of Kharg Island or declaring victory to execute a rapid exit before US midterm elections.
